sources.title: abenzerps/Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo-Quantized · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The base model, Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, natively supports uncensored image generation. No built-in safety checker or content filter is applied, and no special settings are needed. 1024 × 1024 generation takes approximately 10–20 seconds on GPU after warm-up, depending on hardware.

sources.title: qwen-image-2.1-turbo - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is an open-source image generation model in the Qwen-Image series. It offers a compact model size, strong performance, and cost efficiency, with native transparency and unified generation and editing. Editing supports multiple references, local control, and high-fidelity restoration.
